title_zh: 政策工具与企业成长阶段卡库
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: These are proposed policy and enterprise-development instruments for a bounded AI innovation belt. They are not current policy, procurement approval, funding,招商承诺, legal advice or evidence of local enterprise performance.

cards.title: 公共 AI 系统登记与反馈卡
cards.problem: A supplier and a public client need a shared plain-language record before a pilot enters a public workflow.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Every S04 or S08 pilot publishes purpose, data boundary, accountable operator, current state, non-AI equivalent and complaint route on the status board.
cards.operator: district service lead + named pilot operator
cards.stop_gate: No card or no accountable operator means no public test window.

cards.title: 算法服务采购前置记录
cards.problem: Public buyers and suppliers often discuss model capability before agreeing on purpose, limits, human review and remedy.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S04, S08 or S09 expands, publish a compact record covering purpose, affected service, data owner, review owner, alternatives, stop condition and redress route.
cards.operator: district procurement lead + service owner + supplier compliance lead
cards.stop_gate: Missing purpose, data owner or human review blocks procurement and public testing.

cards.title: 企业模型安全验证窗口
cards.problem: A small firm needs a bounded place to reproduce safety and explainability tests before a public workflow becomes a live deployment.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Reserve a Zhongzhi Garden S04 test window with clean test data, model card, red-team note, human takeover drill, incident log and rollback rehearsal.
cards.operator: test-room operator + district safety lead + independent evaluator
cards.stop_gate: Unknown data provenance, failed takeover or missing incident log rejects the next token.

cards.title: 多渠道产品反馈与决策回执
cards.problem: Companies and public teams need usable feedback without making an account, device or digital fluency a condition of participation.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S05 or S08, pair the contribution wall and online ledger with staffed paper, walk-in and multilingual channels; publish which feedback changed the service or policy.
cards.operator: community curator + service owner + participating supplier
cards.stop_gate: If offline participants cannot reach the same review path, the pilot cannot claim representative feedback.

cards.title: 结果导向的公共 AI 采购闸门
cards.problem: A successful demonstration is not enough to justify scale; buyers need observable service outcomes, cost boundaries and an exit path.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S08 or S09, define outcome, baseline, manual comparator, ownership, data retention, service level, total lifecycle cost and scale-or-retire decision before a second window.
cards.operator: district procurement lead + accountable service owner + finance reviewer
cards.stop_gate: No measurable public outcome or no manual comparator means no scale procurement.

cards.title: 公开问题清单与初创挑战赛卡
cards.problem: Startups need a real service problem and a bounded data boundary, while public teams need to avoid buying a solution before defining the problem.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Publish quarterly S08/S09 challenge briefs with user, service failure, non-AI baseline, allowed data, review owner, test window and no-go claims.
cards.operator: enterprise service lead + university/community problem owner
cards.stop_gate: No named problem owner or no non-AI baseline means the challenge is research only, not a procurement lead.
